description_en: Queries model connections in a specified workspace with paging. Supports filtering by name, provider type, and invoke protocol
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型连接，支持按名称、供应商类型和调用协议筛选
name: ListModelConnections

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not set or is set to 0, the default value 10 is used
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回数量。取值范围为 0～100，未设置或设置为 0 时默认为 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Pass the token returned in the previous query. An empty response indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌。请求时传入上一次查询返回的令牌；响应为空表示没有下一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The model connection name. The name must be 1 to 128 non-whitespace characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模型连接名称，长度为 1～128 个非空白字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The name matching mode. Takes effect only when Name is set. Valid values: accurate (exact match), blur (fuzzy match). Default value: blur
parameters.help_zh: 名称匹配方式。仅在设置 Name 时生效。取值：accurate（精确匹配）、blur（模糊匹配）。默认值为 blur
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en: The model provider type used to filter model connections
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选模型连接的模型供应商类型
parameters.name: provider_type

parameters.help_en: The invocation protocol used to filter model connections
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选模型连接的调用协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return associated model summaries for each model connection. By default, model summaries are not returned
parameters.help_zh: 是否在每个模型连接中返回关联模型摘要；默认不返回
parameters.name: include_models

schema.description_en: The model text response returned when model debugging succeeds. This value is empty when debugging fails
schema.description_zh: 模型调试成功时返回的模型文本响应；调试失败时为空

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates success

items.description_en: The business value of this field

apiKeyCount.description_en: The number of API keys configured for the model connection
apiKeyCount.description_zh: 模型连接中已配置的 API Key 数量

createdAt.description_en: The time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 资源创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

credentialConfigured.description_en: Indicates whether access credentials have been configured for the model connection
credentialConfigured.description_zh: 是否已为模型连接配置访问凭据

description.description_en: The description of the model connection. Maximum length: 255 characters
description.description_zh: 模型连接描述，最长 255 个字符

endpoint.description_en: The absolute HTTP or HTTPS address of the upstream model service. Maximum length: 1024 characters
endpoint.description_zh: 上游模型服务的绝对 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址，最长 1024 个字符

models.description_en: The list of model summaries associated with the model connection
models.description_zh: 模型连接关联的模型摘要列表

items.description_en: The business value of this field

name.description_en: The model connection name. The name must be 1 to 128 non-whitespace characters in length
name.description_zh: 模型连接名称，长度为 1～128 个非空白字符

protocol.description_en: The model invocation protocol. Currently only OpenAI/v1 is supported. If not configured in Settings when the model connection is created, this default value is used
protocol.description_zh: 模型调用协议。当前仅支持 OpenAI/v1，创建模型连接时未设置则使用该默认值

statusReason.description_en: The failure summary returned when the model connection fails to be published or fails to be deleted but remains in the Deleting state. This value is empty for other states
statusReason.description_zh: 模型连接发布失败，或删除失败但仍处于删除中时返回的失败摘要；其他状态为空

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the resource was last updated, in RFC 3339 UTC format
updatedAt.description_zh: 资源最后更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

maxResults.description_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not set or is set to 0, the default value 10 is used
maxResults.description_zh: 单页返回数量。取值范围为 0～100，未设置或设置为 0 时默认为 10

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token. Pass the token returned in the previous query. An empty response indicates that no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 分页令牌。请求时传入上一次查询返回的令牌；响应为空表示没有下一页

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of resources that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的资源总数
